public.text: “What is covered, for whom, and under which conditions” may imply that the registry makes individual eligibility determinations.
public.suggestedRevision: Clarify that it publishes general entitlement and coverage definitions, while operational systems determine person-specific eligibility using current enrolment and contextual data.
